newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's NSW to announce Axiom winner next week.
newsitem.headline: Australia's NSW to announce Axiom winner next week.

text.p: New South Wales Treasurer Michael Egan would announce who would buy the government's Axiom Funds Management next week, a spokesman for Egan said on Thursday.
"It'll be within the next week," the spokesman told Reuters, adding that there would not be announcement either on Thursday or Friday.
Two bidders are seen left in the running to buy the rights to manage the A$18 billion in funds under Axiom's control.
They are the Deutsche Bank AG owned Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG) and the National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB).
The Axiom sale is expected to raise over A$200 million.

Deutsche is reported to have offered to move its Asian funds management operation to Sydney from Singapore if its bid was successful, while NAB is reported to have promised to move its National Australia Asset Management arm from Melbourne to Sydney.
